# itzsa

> Open-source React and TypeScript npm packages (@itzsa/*) for Nepal-ready product UIs.
> Primary docs: https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np
> npm org: https://www.npmjs.com/org/itzsa
> Monorepo: https://github.com/SumanPoU/package

## High-intent packages

- [@itzsa/table](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/table): React DataTable — sorting, pagination, filters, CSV/Excel export, tree data, row selection. Keywords: react datatable, next.js table, shadcn datatable.
- [@itzsa/page-builder](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/page-builder): Drag-and-drop React page builder (Elementor-style). Keywords: react page builder, visual editor.
- [@itzsa/nepali-datepicker](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nepali-datepicker): Bikram Sambat (BS) date / datetime / range pickers.
- [@itzsa/nepal-pay](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nepal-pay): eSewa ePay v2, Khalti KPG-2, ConnectIPS TypeScript SDK.

## All packages

- [@itzsa/table](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/table): React DataTable
- [@itzsa/page-builder](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/page-builder): Visual page builder
- [@itzsa/nepali-datepicker](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nepali-datepicker): Bikram Sambat datepicker
- [@itzsa/nepali-input](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nepali-input): Nepali Unicode / Preeti input
- [@itzsa/bs-date](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/bs-date): Headless BS date logic
- [@itzsa/nepal-pay](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nepal-pay): eSewa, Khalti, ConnectIPS
- [@itzsa/nrb-forex](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nrb-forex): NRB forex rates
- [@itzsa/a11y-toolbar](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/a11y-toolbar): Accessibility preference toolbar
- [@itzsa/captcha](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/captcha): Math / slider / canvas captcha
- [@itzsa/nepal-geo](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/nepal-geo): Nepal geography selects
- [@itzsa/nepal-geo-data](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@itzsa/nepal-geo-data): Nepal geo dataset
- [@itzsa/editor](https://itzsa.acharya-suman.com.np/editor): TipTap rich text editor

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @itzsa/table
# or
npm install @itzsa/table
```

## Security

See https://github.com/SumanPoU/package/blob/main/SECURITY.md
